Description:
Discover a unique collector's item with this vintage boxed set of crystal rock specimens from Salzbergwerk Berchtesgaden, Germany. The set includes six individual crystal samples neatly housed in their original labeled compartments, each representing different types of salt and mineral stones. These include red, gray, white, yellow, and dark red rock salt varieties, along with an anhydrite gypsum piece as indicated by the German-language insert. The samples retain their natural crystalline texture and are presented in a charming retro box with detailed informational text and decorative artwork reflecting the rich mining heritage of the Berchtesgaden region. The box shows visible signs of age-related wear and some soiling, and the crystals display minor surface residue but remain in solid condition. Ideal for collectors of geological or mineral specimens, educational purposes, or display, this set provides a fascinating glimpse into mineral diversity and European mining history. Enhance your collection with this distinctive presentation from a renowned salt mining area
